selected_records.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot

article.body:
METR paper assesses AI task-time estimates, not vehicle deployment

An arXiv paper titled “On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons—a statistical look at the METR plot” examines estimates of AI capability on software tasks. Its available abstract snippet defines METR’s “50% time horizon” as the human completion time of tasks an AI solves with 50% probability, and says the analysis covers 228 tasks and 26 AIs.

The supplied material gives no result details and identifies no vehicle, autonomy stack, operating domain, safety record, deployment or regulatory approval. It therefore provides no evidence of an autonomous-vehicle development.
